name: Container
description: Centered, width-constrained page container with shared gutters and four width presets.
designIntent: Pages repeat the same mx-auto/max-w/px trio with slightly different values. Container makes the content width and gutters a shared decision so headers, marketing sections and app pages line up.

props.name: width
props.description: Maximum content width. lg is 80rem (1280px); xl is 1400px; full removes the cap.

props.name: padding
props.description: Horizontal gutters. md is px-4 / sm:px-6; lg adds lg:px-8.

examples.title: Page container
examples.description: Shared width and gutters for a page header and its content.

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest same-width containers
antiPatterns.explanation: A Container inside a Container doubles the gutters on narrow screens. Use Section's inner container once.

accessibility.userRequirements: Use a landmark element when the container is a page region and give it an accessible name

compositionRules.relationship: Section renders a Container internally; use Container directly only for custom chrome
